question.worked_solution:
The difference of squares formula is given by

$$
{a}^{2}-{b}^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)
$$

Notice that our expression can be written as a difference of squares:

$$
81{m}^{4}-{n}^{4}={(9{m}^{2})}^{2}-{({n}^{2})}^{2}
$$

Now, we factor our expression using the difference of squares formula:

$$
{(9{m}^{2})}^{2}-{({n}^{2})}^{2}=(9{m}^{2}+{n}^{2})(9{m}^{2}-{n}^{2})
$$

Finally, we notice that the expression in the second set of parentheses is also a difference of squares: 

$$
9{m}^{2}-{n}^{2}={(3m)}^{2}-{n}^{2}
$$

Therefore, the expression can be factored further, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}(9{m}^{2}+{n}^{2})(9{m}^{2}-{n}^{2}) & =(9{m}^{2}+{n}^{2})(3m+n)(3m-n)\end{aligned}
$$
